overall: Atlanta is running hot this afternoon, with current temps already at 86.0°F as of 14:35 ET — matching the NWS forecast high and well above NWP model consensus. Humidity is elevated with dewpoint near 71-72°F, and a slight chance of afternoon convection (20% PoP after 2pm) adds some downside risk to further warming.
